tt_provider: Choose where the model runs. Local for offline work, cloud for hosted models.
tt_model: Choose which model to use. If the list is empty, refresh it or check the provider account.
tt_refresh: Reload the model list. Use after adding a new model or API key.
tt_rate_limit: Pause between requests in milliseconds. Increase for free providers that return 429 errors.
tt_keep_alive: How long Ollama keeps the model in memory. Example: 5m.
tt_debug: Show detailed logs in the console.
tt_config: Settings received from the Loader node.
tt_image: Image or batch to analyze. Leave disconnected to generate from Prompt field.
tt_preset: Ready-made setup for a common task.
tt_agent: Agent mode for Optic Scanner. Controls how the model interprets the image.
tt_custom_style: Custom style text. Overrides photo/art/nsfw preset styles.
tt_prompt: Main instruction or source idea. With image: tell the model what to focus on.
tt_neg_prompt: What to avoid in the answer.
tt_lang: Language of the answer. Auto replies in the language of your prompt.
tt_detail: How detailed the answer should be.
tt_seed_standalone: Seed value. -1 = random, any number = fixed seed.
tt_seed: Shared seed value from the Seed node.
tt_model_type: Target image-generation model — adjusts prompt syntax, length, and format.
tt_prompt_mode: Auto picks Hybrid or Two-Stage depending on whether a style is selected.
tt_photo_style: Photographic style overlay applied on top of the base description.
tt_nsfw_photo_style: Adult-only photographic style overlay (alternative to Photo style).
tt_art_style: Art style overlay applied on top of the base description.
tt_nsfw_art_style: Adult-only art style overlay (alternative to Art style).
tt_temperature: Sampling temperature — higher is more creative, lower is more deterministic.
tt_max_tokens: Maximum tokens in the LLM response.
tt_provider_max_tokens: Maximum tokens in the response. 0 = provider default (no explicit limit).
tt_response_format: Ask the model to respond as plain text or as a JSON object.
tt_max_image_side: Images are downscaled so their longest side does not exceed this value.
tt_provider_seed: Provider-side generation seed, if supported. -1 lets the provider pick one.
cmp_before: Image shown on the left side.
cmp_after: Image shown on the right side.
cmp_swap: Swap which image is shown as before/after.
cmp_resize_mode: Off keeps images untouched. Preview modes downscale for a lighter preview and, optionally, output.
cmp_max_resolution: Maximum width or height used when resizing is enabled.
cmp_view_mode: How to compare the two images.
cmp_no_preview: Run the node to see a preview
scn_seed_auto_random: Auto-random — a new seed is generated each run
scn_seed_mode_tt: Random generates a new seed each run.
scn_seed_use_last_tt: Reuse the seed from the last executed run.
scn_seed_new_fixed_tt: Generate a new random fixed seed.
sd_mode: Random generates a new seed each run.
sd_use_last: Reuse the seed from the last executed run.
sd_new_fixed: Generate a new random fixed seed.
nc_clean_vram: Enable VRAM cleanup. Frees GPU memory from unused models.
nc_offload_model: Unload models from VRAM when not in use.
nc_clean_ram: Enable RAM cleanup. Frees system memory.
utc_tile_size: Base tile size in pixels for tiled upscale.
utc_overlap: Tile overlap in pixels. Higher = fewer seams, more VRAM.
utc_auto_mode: Full Auto: automatically choose tile settings based on profile.
utc_manual_tile_cols: Manual tile columns for custom grid.
utc_manual_tile_rows: Manual tile rows for custom grid.
utc_manual_cols: Force this many tile columns. 0 = compute from tile size.
utc_manual_rows: Force this many tile rows. 0 = compute from tile size.
utc_max_mp: Megapixel cap for the upscaled image. 0 = no cap.
utc_non_square: Enable non-square tiles with aspect-ratio awareness.
ks_preview: How the live sampling preview is rendered.
ks_vae_decode: Decode the result to an IMAGE preview/output. Needs a VAE.
ks_vae: VAE for decoding the preview/output image.
ks_script: Optional FiL HighRes-fix script to run after sampling.
hrf_upscale_type: Upscale in latent space, pixel space, or both.
hrf_ckpt: Checkpoint for the hires pass. '(use same)' reuses the base model.
hrf_same_seed: Reuse the sampler's seed for the hires pass.
hrf_denoise: Denoise strength for the hires re-sample.
hrf_iterations: How many upscale+resample passes to run.
hrf_use_cn: Guide the hires pass with a ControlNet.
hrf_script: Optional upstream FiL script to extend.
